facts.value: Seize the opportunity to pursue a rigorous degree program led by dedicated, research-oriented faculty and distinguished practitioners. Our instructors employ cutting-edge teaching methods and challenge you to engage with complex, real-world economic issues.
facts.programme_association: Master in International Economics and Economic Policy

facts.value: Studying alongside a diverse international student body, you’ll gain a truly global perspective—making this master’s program an ideal launchpad for an international career.
facts.programme_association: Master in International Economics and Economic Policy

facts.value: The Master of Science in International Economics and Economic Policy offers a structured, research-oriented curriculum that combines rigorous core training with a wide range of courses exploring key dynamics in the global economy.
facts.programme_association: Master in International Economics and Economic Policy

facts.value: Students begin with foundational modules in international economics, public policy, econometrics, macro- and microeconomics.
facts.programme_association: Master in International Economics and Economic Policy

facts.value: Students continue with advanced electives, practitioner-led supplementary courses, seminars, and a master’s thesis.
facts.programme_association: Master in International Economics and Economic Policy

facts.value: This carefully designed program provides both theoretical depth and practical perspective, preparing graduates for careers in academia, international organizations, government institutions, or national and multinational corporations.
facts.programme_association: Master in International Economics and Economic Policy

facts.value: You can apply for the master's program from January 15 until May 15 (application for the first semester).
facts.programme_association: Master in International Economics and Economic Policy
